# MaNoir Documentation

> Documentation for MaNoir, a self-hosted home platform covering installation, operation, and plugin extension.

MaNoir brings together administration, home automation, daily life management, and possession tracking in a system you install and operate yourself.

Base URL: https://manoir-app.github.io

## Main Documentation

- [Self-Hosted Installation](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation): Install and operate MaNoir on infrastructure you control, with Docker as the most concrete current path and Kubernetes guidance for small clusters.
- [User Guide](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide): Use MaNoir for administration, home automation, daily life workflows, and possession management.
- [Developer Guide](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/developer): Extend MaNoir by implementing and publishing plugins.

## Installation

- [Requirements](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/requirements): Hardware and software prerequisites.
- [Configuration](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/configuration): Shared runtime settings and secrets.
- [Docker Deployment](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/deployment): Current Docker-based installation flow.
- [Kubernetes Deployment](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/kubernetes): Initial guidance for small-cluster deployments.
- [Upgrade](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/installation/upgrade): Upgrade an existing installation.

## User Guide

- [Administration](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/administration): Manage users, roles, and system settings.
- [Home Automation](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/home-automation): Control devices, automations, and scenes.
- [Daily Life Management](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/daily-life): Work with calendars, tasks, and shopping lists.
- [Possession Management](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/user-guide/possessions): Track inventory, categories, and maintenance.

## Developer

- [Implementing Plugins](https://manoir-app.github.io/docs/developer/plugins): Create, package, and publish MaNoir plugins.

## Full Text

- [llms-full.txt](https://manoir-app.github.io/llms-full.txt): Expanded index of key documentation pages for LLM ingestion.
